disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to treat or destroy diseased bees, hives, equipment, and appliances as directed by the State Apiarist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It shall be unlawful for any owner or keeper of bees who shall have been notified by the Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries or his agents or employees that the State Apiarist has determined that the disease of Foulbrood or any other contagious or infectious disease of bees exists in the hives of his apiary to fail or refuse to destroy or treat such bees

disciplinary_grounds.description: Hindering, obstructing, resisting, or refusing to allow entrance and inspection by state apiary officials
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to hinder, obstruct, resist or refuse to allow such entrance and inspection.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Moving honeybees into the state on combs in violation of the combless package requirement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All shipments or movements of honeybees into the State of Alabama shall be in combless packages only, and shipments or movements of honeybees into this state in violation of the requirements of this section shall be unlawful.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Shipping or transporting previously used beekeeping equipment into the state without authorization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It shall be unlawful to ship, move or otherwise transport into this state for delivery within the state any previously used honey containers or any hives, combs, frames, appliances, supers or other beekeeping equipment or supplies which have been previously used in the keeping or raising of bees

disciplinary_grounds.description: Moving, transporting, or shipping honeybees, combs, or used beekeeping equipment without a permit from the Commissioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It shall be unlawful to move, transport or ship any honeybees, combs or used beekeeping equipment or appliances without a permit from the Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries bearing the approval or countersignature of the State Apiarist.

definition_quote.value: A location or site on which one or more colonies of bees is located.
definition_quote.quote: APIARY. A location or site on which one or more colonies of bees is located.

registration_required.quote: Every beekeeper, owner or others in possession of any honeybees shall, on or before October 1 of each year, register with the Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries every colony of honeybees, bee yards or apiaries in their possession or under their control

apiary_identification_required.quote: the owner or other person in possession of such equipment shall be required to mark all hive-bodies and supers with an easily identified symbol, which symbol or identifiable mark must be approved by the State Apiarist.

colony_count_reporting_required.quote: such registration shall be made upon forms furnished by the commissioner upon which there shall be shown the number and location of colonies of bees with the apiary location or locations

apiary_location_reporting_required.quote: such registration shall be made upon forms furnished by the commissioner upon which there shall be shown the number and location of colonies of bees with the apiary location or locations

movable_frame_hive_required.quote: The State Apiarist or his or her agent may direct and require any owner or other person in possession of honeybees dwelling in hives without movable frames and combs not permitting of ready examination and inspection to transfer such bees within a specified time to hives with movable frames.

neglected_abandoned_hive_nuisance_declar.quote: Any colony or colonies of bees, combs, honey frames, hives, supers or other beekeeping supplies or equipment found to be infected with American Foulbrood or any other infectious or contagious disease of bees which cannot be satisfactorily controlled is hereby declared to be a public nuisance and shall be destroyed by burning

import_permit_required.quote: It shall be unlawful to move, transport or ship any honeybees, combs or used beekeeping equipment or appliances without a permit from the Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries bearing the approval or countersignature of the State Apiarist.

import_certificate_of_inspection_require.quote: All honeybees shipped or moved into the State of Alabama shall be accompanied by a certificate of inspection, signed by the apiary inspector or other official performing similar duties of the state or country from which shipment is made

import_certificate_validity_days.quote: such examination or inspection to be made during brood-rearing and within a period of 60 days preceding the date of shipment.

combless_package_import_exemption.quote: All shipments or movements of honeybees into the State of Alabama shall be in combless packages only

regulated_diseases.quote: full and plenary power to deal with American and European Foulbrood, Nosema, Isle of Wight disease, and other contagious and infectious diseases of honeybees

quarantine_authority.quote: Any apiary or colony of honeybees found infected with American Foulbrood or any other contagious or infectious disease or otherwise found to be kept or moved or transported in violation of the requirements of this chapter or rules or regulations adopted under this chapter shall be placed under quarantine by the commissioner, the State Apiarist or their agents or employees

right_of_entry_scope.quote: The Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries or his or her agents or employees, including the State Apiarist, may enter and inspect, at all reasonable hours, any premises, station, depot, express office, storeroom, warehouse, vehicle, apiary, or any other location where honeybees, beekeeping equipment, or supplies are kept

transfer_permit_required_for_diseased_eq.quote: It shall be unlawful to move, transport or ship any honeybees, combs or used beekeeping equipment or appliances without a permit from the Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries bearing the approval or countersignature of the State Apiarist.

colony_assessment_fee.quote: An annual registration or inspection fee shall be paid by the registrant which shall accompany the application for registration. The amount of such fee shall be based upon the number of colonies of bees owned by or under the control of the person registering such honeybees

inspection_fee_charged.quote: The Board of Agriculture and Industries shall establish a fee to be paid by each owner of honeybees necessary to defray the cost and expense of the inspections which shall be deposited into the Agricultural Fund of the State Treasury.
